## Fixed
- Mobs riding another entity — a villager sitting in a minecart, a mob in a boat, and so on — can now be captured and released correctly. Previously the Capture Net (or Capture Crate) would show the mob as contained but never let it out, and the mob was lost.
- Capture Nets already stuck from this bug can be recovered: right-click a block with a stuck net and it is emptied with an on-screen notice, freeing it for reuse.
